entries.title: Tenerife medics poised for arrival of virus-hit cruise ship
entries.snippet: BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the port in Tenerife where the MV Hondius is soon to dock, after a deadly hantavirus outbreak.

entries.title: Australia's right-wing One Nation party scores historic parliamentary win

entries.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'

entries.title: I will serve - not rule over Hungary, says new PM

entries.snippet: Brian Fennessy, new head of the U.S. Wildland Fire Service, says his agency is 'trying to bring on additional aircraft and bring them on early,' and dismisses criticism of prevention methods.

entries.title: Bobby Cox, Hall of Fame manager of Atlanta Braves, dies at age 84
entries.snippet: The Braves announced Cox's death on Saturday. He managed the team to prominence during the 1990s and the team's only championship in 1995, before retiring after the 2010 season.

entries.title: CDC says threat of widespread outbreak of hantavirus remains low
entries.snippet: As hantavirus has dominated headlines, sparking fears of another debilitating pandemic, the CDC stressed that the risk of sweeping contagion was small.

entries.title: An expert on Iranian politics reviews the status of negotiations to end the war on Iran
entries.snippet: NPR's Elissa Nadworny talks to Mehrzad Boroujerdi of the Missouri University of Science and Technology about the status of the Trump Administration's negotiations to end the war on Iran.

entries.title: Why saying hello to strangers can be good for you
entries.snippet: A study establishes that "social ties" — a fancy way of saying being nice to other, even those you don't know — has benefits. A teacher asked her students to test the thesis in real life.

entries.title: They graduate to six figure salaries, and grueling work

entries.title: Southern Republicans redistrict after Supreme Court rules, Dems lose big in Virginia
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court weakened minority voting rights and prompted Republicans in four states to move to redistrict as part of Trump's push. A court nullified Democratic redistricting in Virginia.

entries.title: Soccer was once considered niche in the U.S. Then came the 1994 World Cup
entries.snippet: Soccer — or football as it's known around the globe — was far from mainstream in the U.S. leading up to the 1994 World Cup. But in the end, the tournament was considered a resounding success. How exactly did that happen?

entries.title: Moscow marks Victory Day with a Red Square parade under tight security
entries.snippet: Security was tight in Moscow as Putin and several foreign leaders attended the parade, even as a U.S.-brokered three-day ceasefire eased concerns about possible Ukrainian attempts to disrupt the festivities.

entries.title: Moscow holds scaled-back Victory Day Parade under heavy security
entries.snippet: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Saturday voiced confidence in a victory in Ukraine as he oversaw a military parade on Red Square commemorating the defeat of Nazi Germany in World War II.

entries.title: Surfers in war-torn Gaza find rare moments of joy in the waves
entries.snippet: Despite the dire humanitarian crisis across the Gaza Strip, where a fragile ceasefire remains in place, a handful of Palestinian surfers are finding joy — and relief — riding the waves of the territory's Mediterranean coastal waters.

entries.title: Fragile Iran ceasefire appears to hold as Iran warns the U.S. against attacks on its oil tankers and other ships
entries.snippet: Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy on Saturday warned that any attack on Iranian oil tankers or commercial vessels would be met with a "heavy assault" on one of the U.S. bases in the region and enemy ships, even as a tenuous ceasefire appeared to be holding.

entries.title: Medical epidemiologist explains what to know about the cruise ship hantavirus outbreak

entries.title: Bobby Cox, longtime Braves manager and Hall of Famer, dies at 84
entries.snippet: Bobby Cox, the folksy manager of the Atlanta Braves whose teams ruled the National League during the 1990s and gave the city its first major title as well as World Series trips that fell short, died Saturday. He was 84.

entries.title: Israeli drone strikes kill 4 near Beirut as southern airstrikes kill at least 13
entries.snippet: The three drone strikes south of Beirut marked another escalation since a ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah went into effect on April 17.

entries.title: Rescuers find 1 body after volcano eruption in Indonesia as search continues for 2 more
entries.snippet: Rescuers on Saturday recovered the body of an Indonesian woman who was caught in a volcanic eruption at Mount Dukono a day earlier, as search operations continued to find the bodies of two Singaporeans, officials said.

entries.title: Pedestrian killed after being struck by Frontier Airlines plane taking off in Denver
entries.snippet: A Frontier Airlines plane hit and killed a pedestrian on the runway of the Denver International Airport during takeoff, airport authorities said, sparking an engine fire and forcing passengers to evacuate.

entries.snippet: David Brooks of The Atlantic and Ruth Marcus of The New Yorker join Amna Nawaz to discuss the week in politics, including the Virginia Supreme Court's decision to strike down a voter-approved congressional map and developments in the war with Iran.

entries.snippet: Rumblings of unhappiness with some of the Kremlin's wartime policies have put the spotlight on Vladimir Putin, who is due to make a speech on Saturday to mark Victory Day, commemorating victory over Nazi Germany 81 years ago.

entries.snippet: The Russian president made the remarks as Moscow and Kyiv observe a three-day ceasefire in their four-year conflict.

entries.title: Hungary: Peter Magyar sworn in as prime minister

entries.title: Germany news: Surf's up again in Munich!
entries.snippet: The Bavarian capital Munich has long been an unlikely travel hotspot for surfers, and the Eisbach wave is open once again. Meanwhile, Germany is about to use all the resources it should have for 2026. DW has the latest.

entries.title: Putin oversees scaled-back Victory Day parade on Red Square

entries.snippet: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the swearing-in ceremony of Adhikari. Meanwhile, in Tamil Nadu, Joseph Vijay's road to power has been cleared after his party secured outside support. DW has the latest.

entries.title: Eurovision 2026: Politics collide with a blockbuster show

entries.title: Germany's sugar tax sparks 'nanny state' debate
entries.snippet: Friedrich Merz's government has agreed to introduce a sugar levy on soft drinks as part of its health care reforms. Critics have called it disproportionate interference, but dozens of countries already have such a levy.

entries.title: Journalist found dead in Colombia's conflict zone
entries.snippet: Mateo Perez, a 25-year-old Colombian reporter, reportedly went missing on May 5 after being detained by guerrilla members at a roadblock.

entries.title: Mexico to shorten school year due to World Cup, summer heat
entries.snippet: Mexican authorities announced a decision to end the academic year earlier than planned because of the World Cup and a heat wave. But the decision sparked backlash from parents' groups and teachers.

entries.title: Iran war: US expecting Tehran's response to proposed deal
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said Washington was expecting an answer from Tehran over a proposed deal to set up talks to end the war by Friday night Eastern time. Follow live.

entries.title: Canvas education platform back online after cyberattack

entries.title: Pakistan: Drop in Gulf remittances puts families on edge
entries.snippet: For millions of households, money sent by Pakistani workers in the Gulf offers a lifeline, helping their families cover basic needs such as food and education.

entries.title: Trump announces 3-day ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia
entries.snippet: The US president said both sides had agreed to halt fighting from May 9 to 11 and to exchange 1,000 prisoners each. Both Ukraine and Russia confirmed the ceasefire and prisoner exchange. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: US: Pentagon releases trove of classified UFO files
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump hailed his government's move to release over a 100 UFO-related documents as "complete and maximum transparency."

entries.title: How real is a coup threat against Russia's president?
entries.snippet: Increased security around Vladimir Putin and a scaling back of public appearances have given rise to suspicions of a coup or assassination attempt. Yet some observers remain skeptical.
